title: Hardcoded color
summary: Highlights late shipments on the Overview with a literal red (#d93025) instead of a semantic color token.
whyItMatters: The most common drift in AI-written UI: a plausible color that looks right but bypasses the palette, theming and contrast review.

expected.note: The suggestion should name the closest text token (--color-text-danger), not the closest color of any role.
